thread:
sanjay: heads up — deploybot failed to promote `release-20240315` to prod. saw `push accepted` then provenance guard rejected. anyone around?

deploybot: deploybot notice: promotion blocked for repo infra/agent tag `release-20240315`. Reason: ambiguous manifest resolution (2 digests found). Attestation check failed between ecr-us-east-1 and gcr-eu. Suggested: pin to a single digest or roll back tag.

maria: :eyes: saw similar in staging earlier this morning — logs showed `Found manifests: sha256:abcd1234, sha256:ef011111`. Could be a mirror + stale mirror re-upload.

jen: if we have two different digests for same tag we must pin. sanjay — what's the last known-good digest from canary?

sanjay: canary was on `sha256:abcd1234`. I'm going to pin `release-20240315` -> `sha256:abcd1234` in prod and re-run deploybot retag. command: `deployctl retag --repo infra/agent --from sha256:abcd1234 --tag release-20240315`

maria: please also update release notes: "publish: tag collision resolved; pin to exact digest to preserve provenance. no code change" — cc @security.

deploybot: ack. Scheduling retry after pin. If retry fails, deploybot will fallback to previous canary for 15 minutes per rollback policy.

sanjay: retag command executed: `deployctl retag ...` returned 0. Verified digest mapping in ecr: `release-20240315 -> sha256:abcd1234`. However cosign attestation missing for the pinned digest in gcr mirror. Uploading attestation now via KMS.

ops-bot: reminder: change window update — hold auto-tag rotation for this release for 24h.

jen: good. Also add a short checklist item to release docs: verify single manifest per tag across mirrors and attestations present (`cosign verify`).

maria: creating quick postmortem note in the release thread. Root cause suspect: mirror job re-uploaded an older digest with same tag due to retry and didn't reconcile manifests.

sanjay: retag + attestation upload complete. deploybot retry succeeded and promotion finished. Leaving tag pinned for 24h and disabling automated retagging for this repo.

jen: next steps: (1) update publishbot to check manifest count before promote, (2) add retry dedupe to mirror job, (3) add a line to release notes. I'll own (1).

maria: I'll own the postmortem and checklist change.

sanjay: thanks team. closing thread when postmortem lands. :white_check_mark:
